description.value:
Crafting with Painter's Supplies by the D&D 2024 rules.

  • You need proficiency with Painter's Supplies.
  • Choose what to craft; the raw materials cost half of its price.
  • Optional (setting "Crafter feat discount on tool recipes"): with the Crafter feat the raw materials cost 40% of its price.
  • The work takes one day of 8 hours per 10 GP of the item's price (at least one day). Several proficient crafters share the days.
